ref_sources: First-row houses along L.G. Smith Boulevard from Arashi to Malmok, both sides of the coast road. White and cream plaster on a coral-stone plinth, terracotta hips where OSM says hipped, windows with a pale frame, glass and open dark-green shutters, and a low coral wall with a gate toward the road. Hides those OSM boxes. Skips the Arashi Beach Shack and the existing glass villa. Does not touch Malmokweg or the Noord grid inland.
